INVESTIGATIONS OF SOFT TISSUE SARCOMA
Investigations
- Diagnosis: Trucut/incisional/excision biopsy + histopathology; FNAC
may be insufficient for necessary characterization and sub-typing
- Radiologic: Chest X-ray, MRI, CT
- Others: FBC, LFT and Serum proteins, Electrolyte, Urea and Creatinine
